header.title: Write, summarise, and answer — at the speed of your business
header.subtitle: Generative AI as a practical assistant for knowledge work
header.description: Generative AI creates text, summaries, and ideas from your prompts and documents. Used well, it cuts the blank-page problem and makes your organisation's knowledge easier to find — without replacing the people who approve what goes out the door.

overview.title: What changes for your teams
overview.content: Marketing drafts briefs faster. Support gets suggested replies grounded in your policies. Leaders get meeting summaries they can act on. The win is not novelty — it is hours returned and fewer inconsistent answers.
